crossRefs.note: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul, or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”
translations.bsb: The Gibeonites said to him, “We need no silver or gold from Saul or his house, nor should you put to death anyone in Israel for us.” “Whatever you ask, I will do for you,” he replied.
translations.kjv: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
translations.asv: And the Gibeonites said unto him, It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul, or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
